notes: Texts you already replied to stay on your Bookings count and keep the Home tile red until you book, decline, or delete them.
Bookings Pending now shows New texts, then a Replied section. Each replied text shows when you replied, and after 3 days it turns yellow with Waiting 3 Days so it stands out.
A Replied count at the top of Bookings jumps to that section and turns yellow when one is waiting. Change the 3 days in Profile under Flag Replied Texts After.
Replied texts can be declined (they move to Declined) or deleted after you confirm.
